author: gpt-5.6-luna
brief: Phase: code review. Role of the person asking: reviewer. Repo kind: a Node.js inventory service for a small retailer (warehouses, SKUs, reservations, an event emitter for downstream sync, tests, docs). The PR adds reservation holds for checkout with expiry. Plant: reserve reads stock, awaits something, then writes, so two checkouts oversell; one async call is not awaited, so its error is lost; the expiry sweep uses the local clock and compares date strings; a catch block swallows the store error and returns success; the release path emits the downstream event before the write commits; the new test uses real timers with a short sleep, so it is flaky. Add one decoy.
